description:
I've been running my business across two AI ecosystems — OpenClaw for autonomous agent delegation and Claude's family of products for deep collaboration and creative work. In this video I break down the vibe of working in each one, where each ecosystem is actually feasible for running real agent jobs, and why Skills are the key to not getting locked into either platform.

If you're building with agents or thinking about it, this comparison will help you understand the real trade-offs — not which one is "better," but where each one fits as we head deeper into 2026.
